doc.description:
This module is an example module for the course AE4317 Autonomous Flight of Micro Air Vehicles at the TU Delft. This module is used in combination with a color filter (cv_detect_color_object) and the navigation mode of the autopilot. The avoidance strategy is to simply count the total number of orange pixels. When above a certain percentage threshold, (given by color_count_frac) we assume that there is an obstacle and we turn.
The color filter settings are set using the cv_detect_color_object. This module can run multiple filters simultaneously so you have to define which filter to use with the ORANGE_AVOIDER_VISUAL_DETECTION_ID setting.

define.name: ORANGE_AVOIDER_VISUAL_DETECTION_ID
define.description: which VISUAL_DETECTION message to receive for orange pixel detection.

define.name: ORANGE_AVOIDER_CAMERA
define.description: Video device to use for OpenCV gate tracking

define.name: ORANGE_AVOIDER_TRACKER_FPS
define.description: Gate-tracker processing frequency, 0 for camera rate

makefile.raw:
OPENCV_ARM_ROOT := $(PAPARAZZI_HOME)/sw/ext/opencv_bebop/install_arm OPENCV_ARM_LIB := $(OPENCV_ARM_ROOT)/lib OPENCV_ARM_3P := $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/opencv4/3rdparty
ifneq (,$(wildcard $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/libopencv_world*)) ap.CXXFLAGS += -I$(PAPARAZZI_SRC)/sw/ext/opencv_bebop/install_arm/include/opencv4 ap.LDFLAGS += -L$(OPENCV_ARM_LIB) ap.LDFLAGS += -lopencv_world
OCV_PROTOBUF := $(firstword $(wildcard $(OPENCV_ARM_3P)/libprotobuf*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/libprotobuf*.a)) OCV_JPEG := $(firstword $(wildcard $(OPENCV_ARM_3P)/libjpeg*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_3P)/liblibjpeg*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/libjpeg*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/liblibjpeg*.a)) OCV_PNG := $(firstword $(wildcard $(OPENCV_ARM_3P)/libpng*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_3P)/liblibpng*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/libpng*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/liblibpng*.a)) OCV_TIFF := $(firstword $(wildcard $(OPENCV_ARM_3P)/libtiff*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_3P)/liblibtiff*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/libtiff*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/liblibtiff*.a)) OCV_OPENJP2 := $(firstword $(wildcard $(OPENCV_ARM_3P)/libopenjp2*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_3P)/liblibopenjp2*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/libopenjp2*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/liblibopenjp2*.a)) OCV_ZLIB := $(firstword $(wildcard $(OPENCV_ARM_3P)/libzlib*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_3P)/libz*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/libzlib*.a $(OPENCV_ARM_LIB)/libz*.a))
ifneq ($(OCV_PROTOBUF),) ap.LDFLAGS += $(OCV_PROTOBUF) endif ifneq ($(OCV_JPEG),) ap.LDFLAGS += $(OCV_JPEG) endif ifneq ($(OCV_PNG),) ap.LDFLAGS += $(OCV_PNG) endif ifneq ($(OCV_TIFF),) ap.LDFLAGS += $(OCV_TIFF) endif ifneq ($(OCV_OPENJP2),) ap.LDFLAGS += $(OCV_OPENJP2) endif ifneq ($(OCV_ZLIB),) ap.LDFLAGS += $(OCV_ZLIB) endif
ap.LDFLAGS += -ldl -lm -lpthread -lrt else ap.CXXFLAGS += -DORANGE_AVOIDER_FORCE_NO_OPENCV $(warning orange_avoider: ARM OpenCV not found in sw/ext/opencv_bebop/install_arm, using fallback tracker for AP) endif

nps.CXXFLAGS += -I/usr/include/opencv4 ifeq ($(shell pkg-config --exists opencv4 ${AND} echo yes),yes) nps.CXXFLAGS += $(shell pkg-config opencv4 --cflags) nps.LDFLAGS += $(shell pkg-config opencv4 --libs) else ifeq ($(shell pkg-config --exists opencv ${AND} echo yes),yes) nps.CXXFLAGS += $(shell pkg-config opencv --cflags) nps.LDFLAGS += $(shell pkg-config opencv --libs) endif
